desc:
You were sent to retrieve a Black Pearl from an abandoned house deep in the forest.
It should have been simple.

But the house is hiding something.
Something that was never meant to be disturbed.

Find the pearl. Explore the house. Follow the instructions.

And whatever you do...
DO NOT RING THE BLACK BELL.

🔔 Story-driven horror experience
🕯️ Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth
🎧 Headphones recommended
👥 Players: 1–5
🎮 Compatibility: PC, Mobile, Console

⚠️ Contains jumpscares, loud sounds, flashing lights and disturbing imagery.

Some things are better left sealed.
